rules.title: FEHA ban on source-of-income discrimination in housing (incl. Section 8 / VASH vouchers)
rules.requirement: Owners may not discriminate against applicants or tenants based on source of income, which includes lawful, verifiable income such as public assistance and housing subsidies like Section 8 and VASH vouchers. Asking about the level or source of income is not by itself discrimination.
rules.coverage_conditions: Owners of any housing accommodation in California.
rules.exemptions: Written or oral inquiry about the level or source of income is not source-of-income discrimination.
rules.quoted_span: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.conflict_note: The document shows only the effective date of the current text (amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776 (SB 267), effective January 1, 2024); the source-of-income protection itself predates this amendment, but its original effective date is not stated in the document.

rules.title: Income standard for subsidized applicants must be based on tenant's portion of rent
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a housing provider may not apply a financial or income eligibility standard that is not based on the portion of rent the tenant pays.
rules.key_value: Income standard based only on tenant-paid portion of rent
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing in California where the applicant has a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Owner may still verify employment, request landlord references, and verify identity.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the applicant has a government rent subsidy.

rules.quoted_span: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date reflects the current text (SB 267, Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, effective January 1, 2024); the underlying provision may predate this amendment.

rules.title: Credit history use for subsidized applicants requires alternative-evidence option (SB 267)
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a housing provider may not use credit history in the rental application unless it lets the applicant instead provide lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay, such as benefit payments, pay records or bank statements. The provider must give reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider that evidence in place of credit history.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing in California where the applicant has a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Owner may still verify employment, request landlord references, and verify identity.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the applicant has a government rent subsidy.

rules.quoted_span: (B) (i) Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay

rules.title: Income standards must count aggregate income of co-residents
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not use an income standard that fails to count the combined income of persons living or proposing to live together on the same basis as the combined income of married persons.
rules.quoted_span: (n) To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income
rules.conflict_note: Effective date reflects the current text (SB 267, effective January 1, 2024); the provision likely predates this amendment, but the original date is not stated in the document.
